facility.name: Imagine and Learn Academy

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 25020 BLANCO RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78260

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: The logs with mushrooms growing on them have not been removed from the playground area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child did not have a physician's health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One child's enrollment form did not have the address for the emergency contact listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The Emergency Preparedness Plan was found to be incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the inspection, there were multiple walls with peeling paint. There was a wall with trim that was damaged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection, there were dead bugs and cigarette butts found in different areas of the daycare.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation's last sanitation inspection report  was dated 4/30/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: During the inspection, the staff files, personnel files, and operational documents were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During the inspection, the operational documents, staff files, and children's files were not available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used: During the inspection, the menu posted was dated 2025 and was not being followed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used (26 TAC §746.3313(2))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: During the inspection, a yogurt tub containing chemical cleaner was observed underneath a sink in the restroom, accessible to children.    *Note, this was corrected at inspection when the chemicals were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: During the inspection, mushrooms were observed growing on the logs on the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection, there was an outlet uncovered in the activity room.     *Note, this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver covered the outlet
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: The diaper changing mat and table contained debris, bugs, and trash.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: There were 8 children in care ages 16m, 2yearrs, 3years, 3years, 3years, 4years, 4years, and 5 years of age.  For 12 or fewer childre in care, the correct ratio is 1 child 0-17 months, 5 children 18months-4 years, and 5 children 5 years and older.  The operation was caring for 6 children 18 months-4 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection 2 children left the classroom to go to another classroom across the hall.  Both children were unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: There were 11 children in care ages 15 months, 21 months, 2 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 4 years, 4 years, 5 years with one caregiver.  The correct ratio is one infant, 5 children 18 months-4 years, and 5 children 5 years and up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care: The operation is providing care for an infant when they are licensed for toddler-school age care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care (26 TAC §746.301(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The grass on the pre-k playground was observed to be overgrown measuring at approximately 7in high.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Clorox clean-up wipes were observed being stored on a small shelf that children could easily access.      Note: This was CORRECTED AT INSPECTION when the caregiver moved the Clorox wipes to a high shelf that children cannot reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The slide on the pre-k playground did not have 6 inches of loose fill.  Loose-fill was measuring at about 5 inches deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation's  emergency preparedness plan was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: Letter magnets were in the toddler classroom and posed a choking hazard.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director removed magnets from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguishers mounted in the toddler classroom, kitchen, and in the front office area has not been serviced since January 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A monthly  fire drill was not conducted in February 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The fence surrounding the outdoor play area had a broken board and gaps between the fencing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location: The evacuation diagram was missing the designated location outside of the child-care center where all caregivers and children meet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operations Emergency Preparedness Plan was missing the responsibility of staff in an emergency evacuation or relocation to move the children to a designated safe area or alternate shelter and how children in attendance at the time of the emergency will be accounted for at the designated safe area or alternate shelter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: The evacuation diagram was missing the designated location inside the operation for children and staff to meet to take shelter from threatening weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Child cots were stored standing up next to the hand washing sink and a box containing miscellaneous toys was stored in a large box inside the PreK bathroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operation's policy did not included the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that included: the benefits of physical activity and outdoor play; the duration of physical activity; the type of physical activity (structured and unstructured); the criteria used to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play and a plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The use zone around rocking equipment did not have required loose fill of six inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
